purpose: Teach: 角栄/野茂/バチカン/アーセナル/レオナルド/コスタリカ/苫小牧/クウェート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、田中角栄の伝記がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you know? The customer loves Kakuei Tanaka's biography.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Soft opening, warm tone. Sharing something noticed about someone else. Slight lift at the end, inviting Aoi into the observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、野茂英雄の大リーグ時代がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh really? The customer told me she's fond of Nomo's time in the majors.
lines.style: Light surprise, engaged listening. Natural conversational rhythm. Aoi matching Mei's warmth but with her own layer of attentiveness — noticing what customers tell her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バチカン市国を訪問されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did she mention visiting Vatican City?
lines.style: Softer now, building the picture. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Mei piecing together the shape of someone she hasn't met. Almost wondering aloud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アーセナルのサポーターだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mm-hmm. And she supports Arsenal, apparently.
lines.style: Gentle nod in the voice. Not surprised — just adding another thread. Aoi's steady attentiveness, the quiet way she holds details about people.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチ展に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She went to see the Leonardo da Vinci exhibition too.
lines.style: A slight brightness here — Mei noticing a pattern forming. Warmer, more animated than before. The excitement of recognizing something about a person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コスタリカのコーヒー豆を取り寄せてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she special-orders coffee beans from Costa Rica.
lines.style: Building on the warmth. Aoi's voice carrying the detail like it matters — because it does. Steady, affirming. The picture becoming clearer.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、苫小牧出身でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's originally from Tomakomai, you know.
lines.style: Another gentle addition. Mei's tone growing softer, more intimate. Sharing details like opening a book about someone worth understanding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クウェートに駐在経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She actually spent time posted in Kuwait.
lines.style: Final piece settling into place. Aoi's voice quiet, almost reverent with recognition. Slow pace. The tone of someone watching a portrait develop, detail by careful detail.
